description: Split payout vectors: leg count, leg amounts, destination pairs and tags, the running leg sum, and limits on the total only.

vectors.description: Payouts of 1, 2, 3 and 4 legs whose amounts sum to the total are allowed, down to a leg of 1.
A payout with no legs and one with five bound legs that sum to the total are LEGS_INVALID; four legs are allowed.
A zero leg is LEGS_INVALID even when the legs sum to the total, and comes before the sum check; 99 and 1 are allowed.
Legs of 101 and -1 sum to the total of 100 but are LEGS_INVALID, as is a leg of the smallest i128; Stellar only.
Legs of I128_MAX + 1 and of 2^128 + 100, which a 128 bit truncation would read as 100, are LEGS_INVALID; Celo only.
Two legs to bob with no tag are LEGS_INVALID, adjacent or not and before the sum check; bob and exchange are allowed.
Two legs to the same address and tag are LEGS_INVALID, adjacent or not; tags 7 and 8 at that address are allowed.
Legs to one address under tags 7 and 8, and under no tag and tag 0, are distinct bound pairs and are allowed and paid.
A second tag at a bound address is RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWED when its own pair is not bound, and tag 0 is not the absent tag.
A leg whose tag is marked absent but carries 7 is LEGS_INVALID, alone or beside a bound leg; Celo only.
A leg to the zero address is LEGS_INVALID, alone or beside a bound leg; Celo only, as Stellar has no zero address.
A leg to the fee address is LEGS_INVALID with or without a tag, and before the sum check; legs to bound addresses are allowed.
Legs summing to 99 of 100, including thirds of 33, are LEGS_SUM_MISMATCH with no rounding, before the allowlist; 33, 33, 34 is allowed.
A leg larger than what remains of the total is LEGS_SUM_MISMATCH: 60 then 41, one leg of 101, and 100 then 1; 60 then 40 is allowed.
For a total of I128_MAX, legs of I128_MAX twice, or 1 then I128_MAX, are LEGS_SUM_MISMATCH and never overflow the running sum.
Legs each under the per-payment cap of 1000 but totalling 1001 are PAYMENT_CAP_EXCEEDED; the cap applies to the total.
Legs of 999 and 1 total exactly the per-payment cap and the daily cap of 1000 and are allowed and paid.
Legs of 300 each are under the daily cap of 500 but total 600 and are DAILY_CAP_EXCEEDED; the daily cap applies to the total.
Four legs of 333, 333, 333 and 1, one at the largest u64 tag, are kept in leg order and each paid exactly to its destination.
